description: Authoritative, source-cited data across five layers: citizenship- & residency-by-investment (CBI/RBI/golden visa) programmes with the Mirabello Investment Migration Index; country immigration pathways via the origin-aware Freedom Compass planner; HNWI tax & wealth-protection (income/CGT/inheritance/wealth tax, trusts, succession, treaties); qualifying investment real estate; and consultation hand-off. 44 tools. By Mirabello Consultancy (Zurich + Dubai).
